# Active Repository Packet

- **Packet:** `cloudflare-crm-development` — Cloudflare CRM: typed application development
- **Status:** `active`
- **Tracking:** #338, #352, #471
- **Baseline:** `dev` (development scope reference)
- **Source digest:** `sha256:870d6baf5701e7ca76e1a23ca691b25558de1522f4193554cc7b9b402ab104e3`

## Objective

Maintain one Protobuf contract, generated Rust/TS, original owners and one Worker/D1. Issue #352 owns product scope and acceptance; #471 owns the active architecture/typed-runtime work. The former PostgreSQL process runtime and its CI are retired and must not be reintroduced as a second backend.

## Deliverables

- `Access-verified identity and one explicit Rust policy; generated binary Connect dispatch`
- `Original Rust owners, strict React TSX, shared client/UI and behavior tests for each feature`
- `Locked builds, compiled descriptors/router/policy, signed workerd/D1 and real Chromium scenarios`
- `Current canonical D1 schema with explicit migrations or intentional test-data reset`
- `One dev pipeline, Markdown-only build exclusion and deployment of the tested artifact`

## Acceptance

- Code changes pass the existing full CI and live acceptance; Markdown-only changes do not build or deploy
- Current contracts compile together with all consumers; no historical compatibility pin for the development CRM API
- Actual Access A/B, browser, D1/audit, Cloudflare Logs and deployed SHA/version/binding readback
- Issue #352 records tested source, CI result, deployed version and remaining work; app Markdown contains no release checkpoints
- No active PostgreSQL process CI, Docker-backed local database lifecycle or crm-api compatibility build remains.

## Explicit non-goals

- Partial deploy, weakened type/auth/owner/behavior checks, new Worker/D1/Environment/workflow
- Mandatory PR, duplicate PR/push builds or preservation of obsolete test CRM API/UI/data
- Fake feature implementations or deleting Access infrastructure as part of test-data reset
- Restore or extend the retired PostgreSQL process runtime or its CI; preserve shared Rust domain owners, Protobuf contracts and other consumers.
